summary: Iteration 14 — Validated the CLEAN v2 Feature-Priority rebuild (per-feature hipri/lopri user groups, on-demand preemption, no SGE, no background daemon). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases PASS — full CRUD + idempotency + overlap-rejection + unknown server/feature 404 + all 6 /request branches (available, already_holding, preempted [oldest lopri victim, db.checkouts row removed], no_victim-neutral, no_victim-all-hipri, not_in_hipri 403, no_priority_config 404) + role-gating (engineer 403 on PUT/DELETE/POST, 200 on GET) + startup invariant (Auto-preempt loop NOT started, only Auto-sync). Frontend: 7/7 critical flows PASS on the live preview URL — /priority renders with priority-page/title/request-license-panel/priority-configs-section; ADD FEATURE flow (add-feature-priority-btn → editor → server select + feature input + hipri/lopri textareas → save-edit-btn → new config-row visible); EDIT flow (edit-config-<id> opens pre-filled editor → modify hipri → save → row reflects update); DELETE flow (delete-config-<id> + confirm accept → row removed); pill-hi-pri-<user> quick-fill auto-populates req-server/req-feature/req-user; REQUEST result card renders for both success and 403 paths with red 'error' tone and detail; /settings loads cleanly (zero page errors, SGE and auto-preempt toggles absent, DEPRECATED placeholder present).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3944 lines — file size has grown significantly across iterations and remains far above the 700-line guideline. The old auto-preempt loop / heuristic candidate code is deliberately dead-but-still-in-file per the comment at line ~3926. Recommend a follow-up PR that (a) deletes the dead _auto_preempt_loop and _heuristic_preempt_candidates, (b) removes the deprecated /api/priority-rules, /api/preempt/*, /api/pending-requests/*, /api/license/request endpoints called out as deprecated, and (c) extracts feature-priority code into /app/backend/feature_priority.py.

request_feature_seat() at server.py:1845 calls kill_checkout() (itself an endpoint) and catches HTTPException to re-raise as 500. The cleaner pattern is to extract a private async _run_lmremove(srv, feature, user, host, display) helper used by both endpoints — currently endpoint-to-endpoint reuse couples request-lifecycle concerns (Depends, audit, etc.).

edit-feature input in Priority.jsx uses an <input list=...> datalist autocomplete rather than a strict <select>. UX-wise this lets admins type ANY string; only the backend rejects unknown features (404). Consider validating client-side against the chosen server's feature list before enabling SAVE to give immediate feedback.

/api/feature-priorities GET is NOT role-gated — any authenticated user can enumerate hipri/lopri usernames per feature. This is consistent with the previous /api/priority-rules behaviour (also un-gated) but minor info-leak. Acceptable given the page itself is admin-only, but worth documenting.

_clean_userlist dedupes case-insensitively but preserves first-seen casing. The overlap check then re-lowercases on its own — fine, but consider storing the canonical lowercased form to remove ambiguity when comparing against checkout users (which use their original casing).

The old deprecated /api/preempt/auto-status and /api/preempt/auto-tick endpoints still exist and respond. UI no longer surfaces them but they should be removed (or at minimum return 410 Gone) in a cleanup pass to prevent accidental re-use.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All v2 Feature-Priority endpoints and UI flows are GREEN. Reusable harness at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14.py uses requests.Session cookie auth and direct pymongo writes to set up saturation scenarios. UI testids confirmed: priority-page, priority-title, request-license-panel, priority-configs-section, add-feature-priority-btn, priority-editor, edit-server (SELECT), edit-feature (INPUT+datalist), edit-hipri (textarea), edit-lopri (textarea), save-edit-btn, cancel-edit-btn, close-editor, config-row-<id>, edit-config-<id>, delete-config-<id>, pill-hi-pri-<user>, pill-lo-pri-<user>, req-server (SELECT), req-feature (INPUT+datalist), req-user (input), submit-request-btn, request-result-card. Auto-preempt background loop confirmed OFF in latest startup logs.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no production bugs found.
